Looking at the error message and reviewing the code, I can see several issues that would cause incorrect results:

1. The `gemmini_mx_read_smem` call has incorrect addressing - it's dividing `j0 * BLK` by `BF16_PER_WORD` but should use proper byte addressing
2. The `SPAD_DEST` calculation and usage may be incorrect
3. The padding calculations and output reading logic need to be fixed

Let me rewrite the code with proper fixes:

```c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "include/gemmini_testutils.h"
#include "include/matmul_data_mx_lut_hw.h"

// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized solution.
void solution(void) {
  // Flush once globally at start of execution to clear state
  gemmini_flush(0);

  // Hoist invariant global configurations completely outside all loops
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    // Partial last M block: compute only the real rows, pad the rest.
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; 
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; 
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;

    // Hoist row-wise activation scales staging and loading out of the j0 loop
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
    }
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);

    int tiles_I = BLK / DIM, tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    uint32_t a_base = 0;

    // MVIN A tiles directly from strided DRAM - Hoisted out of the j0 loop
    // This caches activation tiles in the scratchpad for all N-blocks
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                              a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
      }
    }

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last N block: compute only the real cols, pad the rest.
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; 
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; 
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      // Stage and load column-wise weight scales (B) for the current j0 block
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      int tiles_J = BLK / DIM;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 0; // Use bottom of scratchpad for output
      int pad_i = BLK - mrows, pad_j = BLK - ncols;

      // MVIN B tiles directly from strided DRAM
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // Configure output store stride
      gemmini_config_st(MATMUL_N * sizeof(out_t));
      
      // Configure requantizer bounds with correct parameters
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // Fused hardware loop computation
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Readout results from shared memory - corrected addressing
      gemmini_mx_read_smem((uint64_t)&C_hw[i0 * BLK * MATMUL_N + j0 * BLK], 
                          SPAD_DEST * 16, mrows * ncols);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
